Deployment checks
1. Validate ports and optics.
2. Stage VLANs and LACP.
3. Test HA + each cable failure.
4. Verify MPIO on both paths.
5. Test guest/IoT isolation.
6. Restore a retained backup.

Known remaining failure points
Branch and DR: one firewall, one switch and one WAN each.
DMZ reverse proxy: one host.
Drawn user endpoints are representative, not a complete fleet BOM.

notes: All addresses, lengths, allocation and configuration are fictional; hardware models are real examples.
Only representative user endpoints are drawn; this is not a complete 180-person endpoint BOM.
1000BASE-T and 10GBASE-T SFP modules are required at indicated Nexus copper links. Verify vendor transceiver/thermal support before a real deployment.
Cisco Nexus pairs use vPC; Catalyst access Po10 and backup LAN5+LAN6 use LACP. Hypervisor vSwitch0 uses independent active/standby trunks with no port-channel.
Keepalive links use dedicated routed VRFs; never infer redundancy from duplicated icons alone.
Shared HA gateway/VIP addresses belong to the cluster and are not duplicate per-device management addresses.
